title: Time of Flight Mass Cytometry (CyTOF)
author: Peter Hinderlie
materials: Cells from separate donors or conditions are stained separately with Cisplatin (Cat. No. 201064, Fluidigm) followed by barcoding using the Cell-ID 20-Plex Pd Barcoding Kit (Cat. No. 201060, Fluidigm).

The following morning, cells are washed in either Maxpar PBS (Cat. No. 201058, Fluidigm), Maxpar Cell Staining Buffer (Cat. No. 201068, Fluidigm), or Millipure Water, with a spin at 1600 RPM for 4 min to remove the supernatant and replace it with fresh buffer.

steps.title: Stain Surface Markers
steps.instruction: Combine barcoded samples into a single 5 mL polystyrene U-bottom tube and incubate with the surface marker antibody cocktail.

steps.title: Permeabilize and Stain Intracellularly
steps.instruction: Permeabilize cells and apply intracellular antibody cocktail.

substeps.instruction: Incubate with 0.1% Triton X for 5 min at room temperature
Incubate with intracellular antibody cocktail for 30 min at 4 °C

steps.title: Intercalate Cells
steps.instruction: Incubate stained cells overnight with Cell-ID Intercalator (Cat. No. 201192A, Fluidigm).

steps.title: Run and Analyze Samples
steps.instruction: Run samples on a time of flight mass cytometer (CyTOF 2, Fluidigm) and analyze data.
